description: Na₃NiO₃ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, corners with three equivalent NiO₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, and edges with two equivalent NiO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.56 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with five equivalent NiO₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.43 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.53 Å. Ni is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NiO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with five equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NiO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 1.81-1.98 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Ni atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Ni atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₅Ni octahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two equivalent Ni atoms.
